[1] Engaging while dodging Taric's E Taric's E (Dazzle) has a long cast time and short range, so when engaging with a W-Q combo, you should dodge or predict Taric's E. Using Flash to evade Taric's E while engaging is also a good strategy.

[1] Engaging after Taric's ultimate Taric's R (Cosmic Radiance) makes allies invulnerable after 2.5 seconds. If Taric uses his ultimate, it's best to wait for the invulnerability to end before engaging with a W-Q combo to trade damage.
[1] Counterplay: Antiheal. W+Q+moo. If he cant auto = he insta dies. Push him away or dont eat autos. W his R engage.

[1] Taric is a strong opponent into melee supports, because when he gets to auto attack, the damage ramps up quickly. Play around his stun and find engages. When he ults in a teamfight you can knock enemies out of the ult range so they don't get the invulnerable effect.

[1] If Taric activates his Ultimate Cosmic Radiance(R) during a skirmish, you have two options to take. You can either try to blow him up and kill him or his ADC before they get the protection, or you can disengage and wait for it to disappear before fighting again.
[1] If you use combo on taric or on his adc he will just use E and they have easy access to your adc
[2] Can win in an all in, but make he can isolate your ADC pretty well. Punish when he wastes his E.
[2] A good Alistar will hold his engage tools until after you expend your E, while you can punish by holding your E as well.
[2] You counter his engage with your stun and he is meele, so u can spam Q+2xAA when he engages.
[2] If they engage on you stun them with E and go all in on their Adc. As long as you hit the Adc you can heal your Adc with Q.
[2] When playing against Alistar it is important to stay near your ADC and be ready to counter engage.
[2] you can counter his engage in teamfights with your ult or solari. But you cant rly stun him when he engages you because of his cc or you cast it earlier in his dash animation
[2] He's tankier than u and has more CC but u heal, stun and make u and ur teammate immortal for a bit. Train ur ult timing and u should be okay
